description: California deadlines to sue (written contract 4 years CCP 337, oral 2 years CCP 339, personal injury 2 years CCP 335.1, property damage 3 years CCP 338, libel/slander 1 year CCP 340(c)) and the small claims limit ($12,500 individuals, $6,250 businesses). California (selfhelp.courts.ca.gov), as of 2026-11-22. General information only: no legal advice, no representation, no filing; interruption, suspension and discovery rules are not applied.
